annotation.title_clean: Les autorités compétentes pour la mise en œuvre du règlement européen sur l’intelligence artificielle
annotation.title_en: The authorities competent for implementing the European regulation on artificial intelligence
annotation.summary_en: French government page describing which national authorities will enforce the EU AI Act (Regulation 2024/1689), by prohibited practices, high-risk Annex I and III systems, and transparency duties. It names DGCCRF as single contact point and includes market surveillance authorities for machines, toys and medical devices. Subject to parliamentary approval.
key_provisions_or_claims: CNIL, DGCCRF and Arcom share oversight of Article 5 prohibited practices and Article 50 transparency duties.
Annex I product market surveillance authorities (machines, toys, medical devices, etc.) have their remit extended to AI integration.
Sectoral authorities (ACPR, Conseil d'État, HFDS) cover specific Annex III areas; CNIL covers the rest.
DGCCRF coordinates market surveillance and acts as single point of contact; DGE represents France on the AI Board.
PEReN and Anssi provide pooled technical expertise; the scheme is subject to parliamentary approval.
